hook.name: PpandLaunchHook
hook.description: A launch hook for the $PPAND/ETH pool that charges a time-decaying ETH fee (starting up to 25% and reaching 0% after 30 minutes) on all swaps, enforces a 1% max-buy limit during that window, and gates trading behind a one-time openTrading() call. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims and swept to an immutable beneficiary address.
